## Definitions and results

### [1.1 First note](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd)

::: {.summary-item .k-def data-kind="def" data-item="t/alpha/first"}
[Definition]{.summary-kind} Widget [→](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd#def-widget){.summary-src title="1.1 First note"}

A *widget* is a thing with
$$ w = 1. $$
:::

::: {.summary-item .k-thm data-kind="result" data-item="t/alpha/first"}
[Theorem]{.summary-kind} Widget theorem [→](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd#thm-widget){.summary-src title="1.1 First note"}

Every widget is a widget.
:::

### [1.2 Second note](/notes/t/alpha/second.qmd)

::: {.summary-item .k-thm data-kind="result" data-item="t/alpha/second"}
[Theorem]{.summary-kind} Gadget theorem [→](/notes/t/alpha/second.qmd#thm-gadget){.summary-src title="1.2 Second note"}

Gadgets follow from [Definition (Widget)](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd#def-widget).
:::
